title: nixos/services.mysql: Set default data directory for MySQL at option
reason: Applicable: real mysql module + wired test. Real diff moves dataDir's real default expression from a separate config-block `lib.mkDefault (...)` assignment INTO the mkOption's own literal `default` field -- a genuine declaration-level change (functionally equivalent priority-wise, but the declaration itself now carries a real default where it previously had none).
targets_toml: single target mysql, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,mysql], watch=[dataDir].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Unchanged verdict class, but not a rendering-gap case (a real witnessed predicate exists on both sides, `cfg.dataDir == "/var/lib/mysql"`, unresolved because the real test doesn't set dataDir to a literal value oba's walker can see). Base predicate at line 731, head at line 730 -- SAME logical predicate content, just shifted one line because the diff added a new `default` field above it. Same known 'default-only changes invisible to the predicate-only verdict model' limitation already seen with wastebin/snapserver/jenkins earlier this round, not a new finding.
